statement: The first line holds n; the second holds the row of n integers, which contains at least one 0. Move every 0 to the end while keeping the order of all non-zero values. Print the resulting row on one line separated by spaces. The length does not change.

example.why: The non-zero values keep their order and the three zeros follow them.

hint: Write each non-zero value into the next output position, then fill the remaining positions with 0.
mistake: Swapping a non-zero value with a zero and accidentally reversing two non-zero values.
